texts.li: [new] "Out past the fields," {A_nameDef} says, still out of breath from running in. "A rare one. Come and look." It's {X_indefinite}, the kind trainers spend years looking for, and the colony has never caught one. It's taking its time out there, and it won't stay more than a day or two.

[known] Since dawn, {A_nameDef} has been watching {X_indefinite} out on the colony's land, a rare one and a fine one. The colony has caught its kind before, but never one like this. It will be gone in a day or two.

[trainer] {A_nameDef}'s Pokémon noticed it first and went very still. Then {A_nameDef} saw it too: {X_indefinite}, a rare one, out past the fields. {A_nameDef} has a hand on {A_possessive} belt already. It won't stay long.

[shiny] {A_nameDef} couldn't believe it at first. It's {X_indefinite}, rare enough already, and this one is shining in the wrong colors, catching the light like a coin. It's on the colony's land for a day or two, no more.

li.label: Everyone out to see it
li.outcome: A handful of colonists crept out together and lay flat in the grass to watch the rare one go about its business. They came back with grass stains, and a story that grew on the way home.

li.label: a look at the rare one
{A_nameDef} goes after it
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} has gone out to follow the rare one and learn its ways, and to try for it, if the colony has a belt to throw.

li.label: Let it pass
li.outcome: The colony lets the rare one be. It stayed out at the edge of the land for a while, looked toward the walls once, and went on its way.

texts.li:
[new] A trainer of {FACTION}, {X_nameDef}, has stopped at the gate with a story: a {TALE} in the wrong colors, shining like a coin, seen twice this season a few days from here and never caught. Every trainer on the road is looking for it. The colony has never caught a {TALE} of any color.
{X_nameDef} will be moving on in a few hours, after the rumour and in front of it.

[known] {X_nameDef}, a trainer of {FACTION}, has stopped at the gate with a story the colony has half heard already: a shiny {TALE}, seen in the region twice this season and caught by nobody. The colony has a {TALE} of its own, of the ordinary color.
{X_nameDef} is moving on in a few hours, to look.

[trainer] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} spotted {A_nameDef}'s Pokémon from the road and came up to the gate to talk shop, and to pass on a rumour: a shiny {TALE} in the region, seen twice and caught by nobody. {A_nameDef} has heard of shinies and never seen one.

li.label: Keep an eye out for it
li.outcome: The word goes round: a shiny {TALE}, somewhere about. For the next twenty days the colony looks twice at every {TALE} it sees.

li.label: Send {A_nameDef} out to look along the way
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} went out to the far edge of the land with {X_nameDef} and looked, and came back with nothing but a better idea of where a shiny might hide. The colony will keep an eye out.

li.label: Just a story
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} shrugs and goes on down the road after the rumour. The colony has work to do.
